request.style: English, acoustic singer-songwriter, soft clear female vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, cello, light piano, gentle shaker, still and steady, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When the night is long and restless and my mind will not lie still
And my thoughts run like a river, running anywhere they will
I set my mind upon you like a city on the stone
With salvation for its walls, and I am not alone

[Chorus]
You keep in perfect peace the mind that is steadfast
Because it trusts in you
Trust in the LORD forever
For in the LORD, the LORD himself, is an everlasting rock

[Verse]
Every storm that shakes the windows, every wave against the shore
Breaks upon a rock that stood a thousand years before
I will lean my weight upon you, I will build my house on you
You are steady in the morning and the evening through

[Chorus]
You keep in perfect peace the mind that is steadfast
Because it trusts in you
Trust in the LORD forever
For in the LORD, the LORD himself, is an everlasting rock

[Bridge]
Perfect peace, perfect peace
The mind that is steadfast
Because it trusts in you

[Outro]
Trust in the LORD forever
An everlasting rock
